title: ConfigError missing #[non_exhaustive] in both reader and imap
description: reader::config::ConfigError and imap::config::ConfigError are public enums with no #[non_exhaustive] attribute. Adding a new error variant (e.g. TlsConfig, BackendConfig) is a breaking change for any code that exhaustively matches on them. Since both enums are in library-facing code and are actively growing (reader config has 12+ validation branches), they should be #[non_exhaustive] now. Adding #[non_exhaustive] later is also a breaking change for callers using _ wildcard patterns that would otherwise warn. The safe window is before the first external consumer.
